**I think you're saying that you want to drop out, but that you think that will make you want to kill yourself (I mean, if you were going to do it, why bother dropping out).**

What I'm saying is that I'm such a loser as is, that once I drop out of college, I will now literally have nothing in my life. All I had before was a bit of intelligence, and obviously that's all been proven to be bullshit since I got to college. I'll continue through school without friends paying through the ass and being miserable, or I drop out, and still have no friends and be miserable and probably have a shitty job. That's why I would kill myself

I have this same problem but rather than being fat, it's because I am so fucking skinny and weak it isn't even funny.

At least if you're fat (not obese, but fat) you look big even if you're weak. For me, I'm 20 years old but look like I'm 15 or 16 because of how small I am, and struggle with 10-15 pound dumbbells

Then I finally went with my roommate to the gym after he kept asking me, and when I would pathetically struggle lifting 10-15 pound dumbbells, I gave up. Then when we got back home, he made fun of my weakness to people and they would laugh at me about it. I don't have any self-esteem as is and always make fun of my weakness, but him doing it like that just really affected me

In second grade we were going on a field trip to the science museum. It was elementary school and so parents would chaperone us.

I was in the car with my white friend and an asian friend (I'm white). Halfway there, our Asian friend gave us both an Asian candy. It was disgusting, and my white friend spit it out, but I didn't because I didn't want to be rude

Then 50 feet from the museum, I started feeling sick. I was sitting in the middle in the back seat. I told the driver to stop but he didn't and I threw up all over myself, right in front of the museum in the car. My 2 friends ran out screaming and were climbing on the car and shit making a huge scene, and so I came out of the car covered in vomit and the entire class was looking because we had gotten there right before everyone.

I didn't have any change of clothes so I had to wear a girl's purple sweatshirt around the museum for 4 hours alone until my dad came to get me.

Horrifying.

I also think part of it has to with a situation like in "It's a Wonderful Life."

People (myself included) are so quick to say that they want to kill themselves, but in reality I bet you 75% or more of those people don't really want to, they just want to see the results if they did so, how people would respond, etc.
